persons.name: Bhūpatīndramalladeva
persons.evidence: śrīśrībhūpatīndramarlladevasana bhotayā kvāṭha prati(7)sthā yātā thva ṅāthānayā dakṣiṇadoyatā putha dayakase bijyāka juro

purpose: bhotayā kvāṭha prati(7)sthā yātā (for the consecration of the fort of Bhota)
notes: King Bhūpatīndra Malla of Bhaktapur had this manual (putha) made for the consecration/establishment of the Bhota fort (bhotayā kvāṭha pratiṣṭhā yātā... putha dayakase bijyāka juro).
